item.title: Temporary lane closures scheduled in Columbia County for utility work
item.description: Columbia County Water Utility is advising motorists of temporary lane closures this week due to scheduled utility repair work at two locations in the county. The post Temporary lane closures scheduled in Columbia County for utility work appeared first on The Augusta Press.

item.title: Brier Creek Conservation District accepting entries for poster, photo contests
item.description: The Brier Creek Soil and Water Conservation District is accepting entries for its annual poster and photo contests, open to students and amateur photographers within the district’s service area. The post Brier Creek Conservation District accepting entries for poster, photo contests appeared first on The Augusta Press.

item.title: Harlem City Council recognizes local VFW, adapts city comprehensive plan
item.description: The Harlem City Council started its first regular meeting of 2026, and the first meeting with two new council members Joshua Brantley and Dustin Driggers, recognizing the city’s VFW Chapter. The post Harlem City Council recognizes local VFW, adapts city comprehensive plan appeared first on The Augusta Press.

item.title: Augusta to revisit grounds shake-up
item.description: Augusta leaders revisit discussion Tuesday of creating a standalone grounds department or tweaking existing services in an attempt to improve maintenance in the Garden City. The post Augusta to revisit grounds shake-up appeared first on The Augusta Press.

item.title: RCSO deputy involved in cheating scandal with RCSS police department resigns
item.description: One of the former Richmond County School System officers involved in a cheating scandal in 2024 has resigned her new position with the Richmond County Sheriff’s Office effective Jan. 26, 2026. The post RCSO deputy involved in cheating scandal with RCSS police department resigns appeared first on The Augusta Press.

item.title: Josey High School principal placed on leave, substitute principal appointed
item.description: The principal of Josey High School has been placed on administrative leave, and district officials have appointed a substitute principal to lead the school while an investigation is underway. The post Josey High School principal placed on leave, substitute principal appointed appeared first on The Augusta Press.

item.title: Burger King workers arrested in Augusta after beef involving gun
item.description: A Burger King brawl that left five employees behind bars last week started when two of the workers showed up late, kicking off an argument that quickly spiraled and eventually led someone to pull a gun, authorities said. The post Burger King workers arrested in Augusta after beef involving gun appeared first on The Augusta Press.

item.title: Officials tease ‘preliminary response’ to HCD audit
item.description: The Augusta Commission received a "preliminary response" to an ongoing audit of the Housing and Community Development department at a closed meeting Tuesday. The post Officials tease ‘preliminary response’ to HCD audit appeared first on The Augusta Press.

item.title: ARCCA highlights timeframe for completion of new arena
item.description: The Augusta-Richmond County Coliseum Authority (ARCCA) now has the recorded deed for the property between Sixth and Fenwick streets, ARCCA attorney Edward Enoch told authority board members during the authority’s meeting, Tuesday. The post ARCCA highlights timeframe for completion of new arena appeared first on The Augusta Press.
